name: read
text:
<path>C:\Users\JonahWu\AppData\Local\Temp\p2-ws-RyNIJC\data.csv</path>
<type>file</type>
<content>
1: category,amount
2: food,120
3: food,80
4: tools,300
5: tools,45
6: food,60
7: misc,25

(End of file - total 7 lines)
</content>

args.command:
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path .\out -Force | Out-Null
$rows = Import-Csv .\data.csv
$groups = $rows | Group-Object category | Sort-Object Name
$total = 0
$parts = foreach ($g in $groups) {
    $sum = [int](($g.Group | Measure-Object -Property amount -Sum).Sum)
    $total += $sum
    '"' + $g.Name + '":' + $sum
}
$json = '{"total":' + $total + ',"byCategory":{' + ($parts -join ',') + '}}'
Set-Content -Path .\out\summary.json -Value $json -NoNewline -Encoding utf8
Write-Output "computed: $json"
args.description: Compute category sums and write summary.json
